name: Rowing (Erg)
coach_notes: Stable cadence, steady power. Tracked 500m benchmark.

name: Bike Erg
coach_notes: Sustained pace. Tracked 1km benchmark.

name: Run
coach_notes: Relaxed posture, steady cadence. Tracked 400m benchmark.

name: Ski Erg
coach_notes: Stable cadence, core engaged.

name: Echo Bike
coach_notes: Max effort intervals 40/20 or 30/15.

name: Barbell Back Squat
coach_notes: Brace, knees out, 2-3s descent, active drive up. Tracked.

name: Deadlift
coach_notes: Control priority, speed on the way up. Tracked.

name: Barbell Bench Press
loading_scheme: 3 sets x 6-8 reps + 1 max-rep speed set
coach_notes: Controlled descent, explosive press. Spotter for max sets. Tracked.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
coach_notes: Glutes/abs braced, vertical press, don't arch. Tracked.

name: Barbell Row
coach_notes: Standard bent-over row. Strict torso, no swing. Tracked.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
coach_notes: Max speed on the way up. Alt to conventional deadlift.

name: Box Squat
loading_scheme: Build a 5RM @ RPE 7, then drop sets 2x7 @80%
coach_notes: Find working load of the day, brief sit on box, controlled rebound.

name: Deficit Deadlift
coach_notes: Brace before pulling, neutral back, straps allowed.

name: Barbell Paused Deadlift
coach_notes: Maintain tension during pause, explosive after. Position strength.

name: Back Squat Tempo (6-0-X-1)
coach_notes: Builds eccentric strength + concentric power.

name: Bench Press Clusters
loading_scheme: 4 sets of 3.3.3 / 2.2.2 / 1.1.1, 3-5s rack rest between clusters
coach_notes: Heavier than continuous sets. Speed + control each rep.

name: Bench Press Wave Loading
coach_notes: Light sets done at max speed, not recovery.

name: Back Squat / Deadlift Contrast (heavy/light)
loading_scheme: 3 sets: 5 heavy 80-90% then 10 light 50-60% at speed
coach_notes: Heavy potentiates light. Stop if speed drops.

name: Weighted Strict Pull-Up
coach_notes: Same load all sets. Bodyweight/band if <5 reps available.

name: Barbell Pendlay Row
coach_notes: Bar resets on floor each rep, explosive pull. Stricter than Barbell Row.

name: Strict Pull-Up
coach_notes: Chin clearly over bar, no kipping.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
coach_notes: Control down, explode up, elbows ~45deg.

name: Strict Bar Dips
coach_notes: Max effort/speed, irreproachable quality.

name: Dumbbell Push Ups
loading_scheme: Max reps 40s. Beginner: standard push ups
coach_notes: Full ROM on dumbbells, max speed with quality.

name: Bench Dips
coach_notes: Max speed, full ROM.

name: Narrow Grip Dumbbell Incline Press
coach_notes: Close grip, triceps + upper chest focus.

name: Single Arm Dumbbell Z Press
coach_notes: Seated legs extended, strict brace, builds shoulder stability.

name: Dual Seated Dumbbell Arnold Press
coach_notes: Rotate wrists through press, all 3 delt heads.

name: Flat Bench Dumbbell Fly
coach_notes: Slight elbow bend held, full controlled ROM. Optional.

name: Single Arm Landmine Row
coach_notes: Strict brace, no rotation. Same load all sets.

name: Incline Chest Supported DB Row
coach_notes: Chest on bench = no lumbar compensation. Alternate L/R.

name: Dual Dumbbell Prone Row
coach_notes: Prone on bench, bilateral pull, no lumbar compensation.

name: KB Split Stance Single Arm Row
coach_notes: Stable split stance, strict pull no rotation.

name: Feet Elevated Ring Row
loading_scheme: Max reps RPE 9. Regression: feet on floor

name: Single Arm Landmine Meadows Row
coach_notes: Constant tension, no compensation.

name: Seated Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
coach_notes: Hinge forward, controlled lateral raise. Optional.

name: Banded Face Pulls
coach_notes: Pull to face, external rotators. Great for shoulder health.

name: Incline Bench Dumbbell Y Raise
coach_notes: Y-raise on incline, mid/lower traps. Optional.

name: Bent Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
coach_notes: Torso ~horizontal, controlled raise to shoulder height.

name: KB Front Rack Front Foot Elevated Split Squat
coach_notes: Front foot elevated, KBs front rack, strict brace.

name: KB Front Rack Wall Sit
coach_notes: Back on wall, 90/90, KBs front rack, max iso tension.

name: KB Front Rack Box Step Up
coach_notes: Alternating step up, KBs front rack, quality over speed.

name: Mixed KB Rack/Suitcase Lateral Box Step Up
coach_notes: One KB rack, one suitcase. Unilateral balance + adductors.

name: Glute Ham Raise Negative
coach_notes: Eccentric only. Optional.

name: Sandbag Front Rack Lunges
loading_scheme: EMOM 20s max reps. Pro 30/20kg, Open 20kg, Beginner 15/5kg

name: Copenhagen Plank
coach_notes: Strict side plank, high hip, no pelvic rotation.

name: Landmine Oblique Twist
coach_notes: Rotate from hips, semi-extended arms, full ROM.

name: Half Kneeling Landmine Twist
coach_notes: One knee down, strict brace, stable hips. Optional.

name: Band Pallof Press to Rotation
coach_notes: Anti-rotation press then rotate. Resist band pull.

name: Tall Kneeling DB Low to High Chop
coach_notes: Diagonal chop, strict brace, stable hips. Optional.

name: Star Plank Dumbbell Rotation
coach_notes: Single-arm plank with DB rotation. Optional.

name: Hollow Body Flutter Kicks
coach_notes: Hollow position, low back glued to floor. Optional.

name: Banded Reverse Crunch
coach_notes: Knees to chest vs resistance, low back flat. Optional.

name: Mountain Climbers
coach_notes: High plank, fast alternating knees, stable hips.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
coach_notes: Band at ankles/knees, constant tension. Glute med activation.

name: Bridge Psoas March
coach_notes: Bridge position, alternate knee march, hold brace.

name: Banded Hamstring Kicks
coach_notes: Band at ankle, dynamic leg extension back.

name: Cobra Walking Lunges

name: Rower Hamstring Curls

name: Wall Ball
coach_notes: Full squat then push, steady cadence.

name: Box Jump
coach_notes: Soft landing, step down under fatigue.

name: Box Jump Over
coach_notes: Soft landing, fluid sequencing.

name: Sandbag Walking Lunge
coach_notes: Stable posture, front knee tracks foot.

coach_notes: Low posture, continuous drive through legs/hips.

name: Sled Pull
coach_notes: Constant rope tension, drive through legs/hips.

name: Farmer Carry (Dumbbells)
